title: Handbell ringing for the Air Ambulance — St James' Harvington Handbell Ringers
body: From now until Christmas Eve the ringers play 24 engagements, mostly at supermarket doors, with every penny going to Midlands Air Ambulance Charity and Warwickshire & Northamptonshire Air Ambulance. Evesham: Morrisons Wed 9 and Thu 17 Dec, 5–8pm; Tesco Sun 13 Dec, 10am–1pm and Wed 16 Dec, 5–8pm. Stratford-upon-Avon: Waitrose Thu 10 Dec, 5–8pm and Sat 12 and Tue 22 Dec, 10am–1pm; Tesco Tue 15 Dec, 10am–1pm and Sun 20 Dec, 1–4pm; Morrisons Fri 18 Dec, 10am–1pm and Mon 21 Dec, 1–4pm. Alcester: Waitrose Fri 11 Dec, 2–5pm and Sat 19 and Wed 23 Dec, 10am–1pm. In Harvington: St James' Church, Sun 6 Dec at 10am, and 23 Ragley Road on Christmas Eve, 6.30–7pm. Listen out for the bells and give what you can.
